INVALID_SHARE_APPEARANCE.zh: 请选择有效的分享外观

SHARE_THEME_CHANGED.zh: 主题已变更，请重新生成预览
SHARE_THEME_CHANGED.en: The theme changed; generate the preview again

INVALID_SHARE_SELECTION.zh: 请选择有效的分享范围

SHARE_ACCOUNT_CHANGED.zh: {reason, select, switch {请切换到发布账号 {username}} changed {账号已切换，请重新生成预览} other {请切换到发布账号 {username}}}
SHARE_ACCOUNT_CHANGED.en: {reason, select, switch {Switch to the publishing account {username}} changed {The account changed; generate the preview again} other {Switch to the publishing account {username}}}

SHARE_ALIAS_EXISTS.zh: 分享地址已存在，请核对发布状态
SHARE_ALIAS_EXISTS.en: The share address already exists; check the publish status

SHARE_ASSETS_UNAVAILABLE.en: The share page has not been built

SHARE_ASSETS_UNSAFE.zh: 分享资源不能包含符号链接
SHARE_ASSETS_UNSAFE.en: Share assets cannot contain symbolic links

SHARE_BUSY.en: A share operation is already running

SHARE_CLI_MISSING.zh: 请先安装发布所需的命令行工具
SHARE_CLI_MISSING.en: Install the command-line tool needed to publish first

SHARE_CLI_PROTOCOL.zh: 平台返回的数据无效，请稍后重试
SHARE_CLI_PROTOCOL.en: The platform returned invalid data; try again shortly

SHARE_CLI_TIMEOUT.zh: 平台响应未确认，请核对状态
SHARE_CLI_TIMEOUT.en: The platform response was not confirmed; check the status

SHARE_DIRECTORY_UNSAFE.en: The share directory must be empty

SHARE_DRAFT_EXPIRED.zh: 分享预览已失效，请重新生成
SHARE_DRAFT_EXPIRED.en: The share preview has expired; generate it again

SHARE_DRAFT_MISMATCH.zh: {reason, select, session {分享预览不属于当前会话} record {原分享预览与发布记录不符} other {原分享预览与发布记录不符}}
SHARE_DRAFT_MISMATCH.en: {reason, select, session {The share preview belongs to another conversation} record {The original share preview does not match the publish record} other {The original share preview does not match the publish record}}

SHARE_DRAFT_NOT_FOUND.zh: 分享预览已失效，请重新生成
SHARE_DRAFT_NOT_FOUND.en: The share preview has expired; generate it again

SHARE_LIST_INCOMPLETE.zh: 无法完整核对平台分享列表
SHARE_LIST_INCOMPLETE.en: The platform share list could not be fully checked

SHARE_LOGIN_REQUIRED.en: Sign in to the publishing account first

SHARE_NOT_VERIFIED.zh: 页面已提交，内容尚未核对，请稍后核对状态
SHARE_NOT_VERIFIED.en: The page was submitted but its content has not been verified; check the status later

SHARE_PERMISSION_DENIED.zh: 当前账号没有分享权限

SHARE_PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 无法完成平台操作，请检查网络后核对状态
SHARE_PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE.en: The platform operation did not complete; check the network and verify the status

SHARE_PUBLISHER_CHANGED.zh: 发布目标已变化，请重新生成预览
SHARE_PUBLISHER_CHANGED.en: The publishing target changed; generate the preview again

SHARE_PUBLISHER_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 发布此分享的插件未启用
SHARE_PUBLISHER_UNAVAILABLE.en: The plugin that published this share is not enabled

SHARE_REMOVE_UNCONFIRMED.zh: {reason, select, publish {此前发布结果未确认，暂不能确认取消，请稍后核对状态} remote {平台仍显示此分享，请稍后核对状态} other {平台仍显示此分享，请稍后核对状态}}
SHARE_REMOVE_UNCONFIRMED.en: {reason, select, publish {The previous publish result is unconfirmed; reconcile it before removing} remote {The platform still lists this share; check the status later} other {The platform still lists this share; check the status later}}

SHARE_RETRY_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 原分享预览不可用，请核对平台状态
SHARE_RETRY_UNAVAILABLE.en: The original share preview is unavailable; check the platform status

SHARE_SELECTION_CHANGED.zh: 所选轮次已不可用，请重新选择
SHARE_SELECTION_CHANGED.en: The selected turns are no longer available; select them again

SHARE_UNCONFIRMED.zh: 请先核对上一次分享操作的状态
SHARE_UNCONFIRMED.en: Reconcile the previous share operation first

SHARE_UNAVAILABLE.zh: {reason, select, missing_cli {请先安装发布所需的命令行工具} unsupported_cli {请更新发布所需的命令行工具} login_required {请先登录发布账号} permission_denied {当前账号没有分享权限} no_publisher {未启用分享发布插件} other {分享暂不可用}}
SHARE_UNAVAILABLE.en: {reason, select, missing_cli {Install the command-line tool needed to publish first} unsupported_cli {Update the command-line tool needed to publish} login_required {Sign in to the publishing account first} permission_denied {This account cannot share} no_publisher {No share publisher is enabled} other {Sharing is unavailable}}
